metric: 120 targets; 2236 test positives; 600 unique negatives; 2836 pairs; 0.996601 / 0.994458; 0.996912 / 0.995381
observation: The first cold-start run held out 120 targets and all their target-disease edges but evaluated with only 600 unique negatives for 2,236 test positives, giving 2,836 pairs. It reported GATv2 0.996601/0.994458, 60/40 GATv2+GraphSAGE 0.996912/0.995381 and a GNN/histogram mix 0.996714/0.995655; the figure was later withdrawn.
subject: F-32
title: First target cold-start run scored 0.997 on a defective sample
